description: This PHP source file defines a class 'ViewModulefield' which extends SugarView. It provides functionalities for rendering and managing the display of module fields in the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM framework, including fetching, rendering templates, and manipulating field definitions in module builder environments.

classes.name: ViewModulefield
classes.description: A class extending SugarView to handle rendering and editing of module fields in the SuiteCRM interface, supporting module builder and standard module field operations.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns the parameters for the module title display, including module name and module title, translated appropriately.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Fetches and outputs the JavaScript associated with the view by calling the fetch method.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Main method to prepare and render the field editing interface, handling different contexts such as module builder or standard module, and setting up field definitions and layout.

methods.name: fetchTemplate
methods.description: Overrides fetchTemplate from SugarView to retrieve template content via the FieldViewer class's Smarty instance.
